response.sql: WITH account_flows AS (SELECT trans.account_id, district.A3 as region, SUM(CASE WHEN trans.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN trans.amount WHEN trans.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -trans.amount ELSE 0 END) as net_flow, COUNT(*) as num_transactions FROM trans INNER JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id INNER JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE trans.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') GROUP BY trans.account_id, district.A3), total_flow AS (SELECT SUM(net_flow) as total_net_flow FROM account_flows) SELECT account_flows.account_id, account_flows.region, account_flows.net_flow, account_flows.num_transactions, account_flows.net_flow * 1.0 / total_flow.total_net_flow as share FROM account_flows CROSS JOIN total_flow ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
